implementation_notes: Use built-ins: `dict`, `list`, comprehensions, `itertools`, `functools`, `pathlib`, `dataclasses`. Prefer a plain function over a class hierarchy; prefer keyword arguments with defaults over configuration objects; reach for a framework only when its replacement cost is clearly paid.
pitfalls: Metaclasses and descriptors for plain configuration
A custom ORM/query builder for a two-table schema
Async frameworks for synchronous code with no concurrency requirement
